entries.2026ddcbdcc964a4: This business is the group's single reportable segment, providing BNPL (pay-later) payment services. Consolidated operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥25,214 million. Under the company, a pure holding company, Net Protections Inc. provides the various services in Japan, En Pei Ke Ji Gu Fen You Xian Gong Si (NP Taiwan, Inc.) operates AFTEE in Taiwan, and Net Protections Vietnam Co., Ltd. operates AFTEE in Vietnam. NP Finance Inc. provides online lending services to companies that buy through NP Kakebarai.
entries.25cffe1986d4a1ff: This business model involves checking the creditworthiness of buyers, paying the sale price to the seller to purchase receivables, and later billing and collecting from buyers, earning fees calculated on the face value of the receivables.

entries.4c87ec2f3b8bfb5f: A payment solutions company that provides B2C and B2B deferred payment (BNPL) services and handles credit screening, invoicing, and collection for merchants.
entries.5126dfdad91543ca: The company launched Japan's first credit-risk-guaranteed BNPL payment service in 2002, and it has a structure that can provide all payment-related functions on a one-stop basis, from credit screening through invoice issuance, payment confirmation, collection and reminders, and bad-debt handling, as well as credit and collection know-how accumulated through many years of operation.

entries.6efcc6148c36d6f1: This segment covers atone, a membership-based BNPL payment service using smartphones. Payments are settled in one monthly bundle, points are granted, and it supports non-physical products such as digital content. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,977 million.
entries.7cd705c1db1a7cae: For B2C, the company targets the EC market, the face-to-face retail store market, the visiting service market, and overseas markets in Taiwan and Vietnam; for B2B, it targets the business-to-business transactions market; through multiple services it approaches a wide range of markets. No major customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue.

entries.a391eb2e5eabfa7d: A pure holding company with its head office in Kojimachi, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, it operates the payment solutions business together with four consolidated subsidiaries. Consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026 numbered 377.
entries.a7925083d6c11559: The company formulates a three-year medium-term management plan on a rolling basis every year, and it positions expanding its earnings base as its top priority. For NP Atobarai, it is promoting the replacement of mail-order companies' in-house deferred payment settlement; for NP Atobarai air, it is acquiring merchants in response to demand for DX in billing operations; for AFTEE, it is focusing on developing overseas markets; and it says atone will pursue the development of the non-merchandise EC market and the expansion of its member base as a growth driver.
